name: Job Result
description: job_result: Wait for an existing Job and return its exact output. A failed, rejected or cancelled target fails this wait. Omit timeout or use 0 for no deadline; a positive timeout limits only the wait. Timing out or cancelling this wait leaves the target running. A target needing input will not finish until that input is supplied to it. Do not resubmit the original operation because a wait timed out. Requires job/read on the target Job; raw CRUD permissions and creator attribution do not grant it.

id.description: Exact Job ID on the selected hosting venue. A local wrapper and its destination are separate Jobs: use the ID of the one you intend to inspect or control. Agent, session and tool-call IDs are not Job IDs.

venue.description: Hosting venue HTTP(S) URL or routable DID. Omit for a local Job, including a local proxy. For a destination Job use its own ID and hosting venue. A definition may set a default venue; this input overrides it. Null is invalid.

authenticateAs.description: Remote identity: anonymous (default) sends no identity or grants; caller requires your identity credential addressed to the target venue, with no capabilities, plus any separate grants; venue is only for the venue itself. Use the same mode and credentials when following the Job. Local calls retain your caller context.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait; omitted or 0 means no deadline. Expiry fails this wait without changing or cancelling the target.

owner.description: Job owner DID. Supply it for another owner, including retained Jobs. This selects a lookup namespace and grants no authority. With a remote venue, omission selects the authenticated principal, or the remote public principal in anonymous mode.

output.description: Exact output of the target Job; any JSON value, including null.
